child.text:
[{"insert":"Dumbbell Cross Body Hammer Curl + Dumbbell Skullcrusher

Two arm isolation movements paired to finish the session with a bicep and tricep pump. The cross body hammer curl pulls the dumbbell across the body, emphasizing the brachialis and brachioradialis alongside the biceps. The dumbbell skullcrusher loads the tricep at the stretched position overhead. Push close to failure on each set with minimal rest between the two movements.
"}]
